description: Brazilian company record by CNPJ from the Federal Revenue (Receita Federal), with the special status when there is one (bankruptcy, judicial recovery, liquidation); its sanctions (CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, leniency agreements, TCU and the CNJ's CNIA, checked live); partners on the politically exposed persons list (CGU); tax status (federal tax debt, installment agreements, tax incentives and construction works); the Federal Revenue chronic tax debtor list (`devedorContumaz.consta`: barred from public tenders); environmental and labor risk (forced-labor list, Ibama embargoes and fines); government contracts (PNCP, federal contracts since 2013 and sales to municipalities in the state of SP, from TCE-SP) and BNDES financing; registrations with regulators and official registries (CVM, Central Bank, ANS, ANTT, ANP, ANEEL, Anatel, Anvisa, CNES, Cadastur, Ibama, ANAC and SICAF); CVM investment funds; and the address on the map (CNEFE/IBGE). Accepts the numeric and the alphanumeric CNPJ. Personal data in the record comes masked. `sancoes` has what public registries record against the whole company (the CNPJ root), updated daily: useful to vet suppliers. 10 free lookups per day per network; after that, the tool answers `free_limit` with `resets_at`.

temas.description: Comma-separated topics: dados, socios, sancoes, fiscal, divida, obras, trabalho, ibama, contratos, pep, vendas, campanhas, prefeituras, sicaf, aeronaves, fundos, rntrc, bndes, registros; todos. Omit for the full record. Basic company data always stays. Unrequested blocks are omitted; null means unchecked. Personal data remains masked.
